reviews.text: Premium service, very professional, a top-notch group 👍
I love this Vet! They are so helpful, kind and fun! Guido (Bambino) loves them too!
Good service. Good professionalism.
Great atención and care. Beautiful enviroment and variety of options.

I've been a customer since they opened, whether it was for a simple nail trim, to ask a question, or for an emergency, I've never had anything to complain about.

The telephone support and availability, the physical space, and the overall service, especially the excellent team of veterinarians/assistants, are unparalleled not only in veterinary clinics but in establishments in general.

The availability to answer questions is excellent!

The space is very welcoming.

It's in an extremely central location and very easy to access.

I have been taking my cat, Catarina, to this vet surgery for several years now and I love the place. I was recommended it by a friend and she was right - the vets are caring and knowledgable, very helpful and professional. Catarina is enjoying a better quality of life becauae of the vets here.

I've been taking my kitten to this veterinary clinic for a while now and I only have good things to say. The service is excellent and the doctor, Beatriz, is very professional, dedicated, and caring with the animals. She explains everything clearly and inspires a lot of confidence. I recommend them without hesitation!
Very good
The veterinary clinic team is always super attentive and friendly.

We can’t thank Dr. Rita and her incredible staff enough for their unwavering dedication and kindness. From the moment we brought our beloved cat with us from the US, Dr. Rita has been there every step of the way, offering compassionate care and expert guidance. Even in the hardest moments, especially when our cat recently passed away, they did everything possible to ensure she was comfortable and loved. Their dedication and warmth truly made a difficult journey a bit more bearable. We are forever grateful for the excellent care and the personal touch Dr. Rita and her team provided. Thank you for everything.

Completely irresponsible!!!!!!
Unfortunately, one of the kittens I had in foster care managed to escape and, according to witnesses, ended up in front of the house and was taken by a couple. The couple went to this clinic to check if it had a microchip and contacted me. I explained that I was on my way to another clinic with an animal that was going to be euthanized and asked them to give me two hours and I would pick it up. They didn't give me any time, they handed Bud over to the people who took him there and didn't even keep their contact information. Months have passed and these "professionals" have done nothing to locate Bud or the people. They gave us contradictory leads just to keep us entertained, and when they ran out of ideas they simply stopped doing it, they didn't bother to put up posters, try to contact the people, nothing... as far as I know, Bud may be dead right now or even being mistreated because of the irresponsibility of the doctors at this clinic who thought that keeping a cat for two hours was too long. This is how we can tell who's in this profession out of love and who's in it because it pays well... (not to mention that the day after this happened, when I called to ask if the couple who took Bud had any news, the person who answered told me to stop calling because they had no more information).

It's rare to find a place where competence goes hand in hand with empathy, but above all, with heart. In this clinic, you immediately feel that each animal is treated as unique and special. It's not just a veterinary service: it's a space of care, respect, and true love.

For me, there's no doubt that this is the best veterinary clinic I know. I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking for exceptional professionals who truly make a difference in the lives of our four-legged companions.

Thank you to Dr. Rita, Dr. Beatriz, and Dr. Diana for all your dedication ♥️

Maria and Grifo

Cat Tongue is the clinic I recommend to all my friends who are looking for a trustworthy place to care for their feline and canine companions. I took Virgílio and Dona Aurora there, two cats with strong personalities who were always treated with patience and love, and sometimes miracles happened in their prognosis. There are times when the familiar relationship with the veterinarian is essential for us pet owners, with our hearts in our hands.
Now I have two other cats (younger and healthier) who are also clients of this clinic for lighter but no less important issues: sterilization, vaccinations, and routine check-ups.
I highly recommend it!

This week, once again, I went to "my" clinic for my cat's usual vaccination. I've been doing this for 5 years and have always received exemplary professional service; you can see the genuine passion for what they do. And small gestures that warm our hearts.
For the first time, I decided to publicly write these words of thanks.
But first, I read the reviews and the statistics confirm it (99.9% 4 and 5 stars and 0.1% negative reviews - the latter surely from the usual "disgruntled" people, the so-called compulsive critics).
Excellence is the way and that has been your motto.
Well done and a very, very big thank you!

Always attentive care for my little one, from his first day of life until he left us. 🥹❤️ Undeniable compassion, always with a smile on their face and a friendly hug, attentive and available for anything. 🥰 I highly recommend them to anyone who wants more personalized care. …

Veterinarians who hand over a microchipped animal to third parties without even keeping the data of those responsible are not good professionals! How can you hand over a microchipped animal to someone who, when contacted, asks you to wait until she can pick up the animal from adopters without the permission of the legal owner of the animal, and without even keeping the adopters' data????? This is not only illegal behavior but also incomprehensible irresponsibility. Where is the animal today?????? A complaint has been filed with the General Directorate of Veterinary Medicine, and we will follow up on the case to document the responsibilities and apply the appropriate consequences. Since we haven't been able to resolve this amicably, we ask that you show interest in discovering the animal's whereabouts.

"It was this clinic that handed Bud over to strangers even after speaking to me (he had my contact information on the chip) and me asking them to be patient because I was at another clinic putting Seferino to sleep 💔 They didn't think twice and handed over the cat without even taking contact information, they didn't even bother to try to locate the people who took him there. I ask you to leave a comment on Google (so they don't delete it like they did on Instagram and Facebook) exposing this irresponsibility and, who knows, maybe force them to locate who took Bud.", quote from Daniela
Avoid. No compassion. There should be an option for 0 stars.
Our kitten went for her first year's vaccination. She behaved very well! She was very spoiled! We loved her! When she got home, she didn't want to leave her carrier!!

Fantastic team, Javita and I were always very well received and it's clear that they are good professionals who truly enjoy what they do. The entire staff was impeccable, especially Dr. Rita. I highly recommend them!

Our cat has been a client of this clinic for a year. They had jaw surgery, a bunch of examinations and injections. Everything is at a professional level. They treat animals very well. Many thanks to Ms. Beatriz 🙏 …

Quick and friendly service for an EU pet passport for our Yorkie using USDA endorsed health certificate and dgav issued documentation received from the veterinarian officer at the airport.  Transaction was done in English at minimal cost. Highly recommend this establishment for EU pet passport service.

Thank you Dr Beatriz - amazing vet and vet clinic. She helped with the EU passport/ docs and also tapeworm treatment for our dog’s UK travel. Everything was smooth and the vet was cosy and homey.

Her charges were also reasonable and very responsive when emailing for appointment.

Would recommend to pay them a vet visit if needed of such service!

TERRIBLE!!!! THEY LET A COUPLE TAKE MY MISSING CAT WITH A MICROCHIP!!!!!!
My docile and sweet cat is missing, and the day after he ran away (May 27th), a couple took him to this clinic to have the microchip read. The vet called the number on it (the lady from the adoption agency who gave him to us), and she was busy at the time with another kitten who was sick and would come later that afternoon to pick him up. However, the clinic/vet didn't want to wait and let the couple take my cat WITHOUT THE VET EVEN WRITING DOWN THEIR CONTACT NUMBER!! They gave them the microchip's contact number, and to this day they have never contacted us!!! We don't know who it was or the clinic, and they haven't helped us with anything or shown any compassion!!! My cat is still missing!! And we have to be LUCKY that they are good people to return my cat, but it's been days already!! It's absurd and shows great negligence to have allowed people who aren't the owners to take it!!!!

We called ahead and got an appointment relatively quickly. The vet is very nice and was incredibly gentle with our dog. She also speaks perfect English. The price is very, very reasonable by German standards!
Tanuki receives excellent care from the staff at Língua de Gato, as well as Dr. Beatriz and Dr. Sara. He is overjoyed when an appointment is over and he receives treats.
I loved the space and the service. They were very attentive to my dog. We went to get his vaccinations and update his health record. I recommend them a thousand times!
An absolutely wonderful veterinary clinic. Friendly, helpful and knowledgeable staff. You are in good hands here!

Recommend 1000%! I’ve taken my cat Jimmy to Língua de Gato for the 3+ years I’ve lived in Porto, he has an autoimmune condition so we have regular appointments and blood tests. Dra Beatriz and the rest of the team are always so helpful and kind and take the best care of Jimmy. We will miss the clinic when we return to the UK!

EU pet passport

A very friendly and helpful vet clinic in Porto. If you’re looking for an EU pet passport they can help you.

I have a dog and travelled from the UK staying in Porto.

Highly recommend

I need to say that this is the first place where I met such involved vets who really care about pets. In the past I had a contact with vets that wrote prescriptions or gave my pet some antibiotics and that was all about appointments. But at this clinic your furry friend can expect real individual treatment.

Diana who is my cat's doctor, gave me a lot of recommendations and I see that they work and keep my cat (12 years old) in better shape.

Here you can find specialists who will help your pet.

I'm sure that Roland (my cat) would also recommend Língua de Gato if he could speak. 😺
A good clinic, very responsive doctors, and wonderful service. Dr. Rita found the way to our cat's heart in 5 minutes, and this is a very difficult task 😆 …
Our kittens are very well cared for by the doctors at the clinic! The attention and affection they give our beloved furry friends fills our hearts. I highly recommend them!
Excellent team, I highly recommend them.

Well recommended! We used their services since the beginning we moved to Porto, received help with all the questions. Our dog needed a teeth surgery, all went very well. Professional, caring, attentive. ⭐️
They have always taken excellent care of my dog and have very kind, knowledgeable and helpful staff. I would recommend anyone bring their pet here for veterinary care
Excellent veterinarian with staff always willing to help, even remotely. Highly recommended.

Everybody is very nice and helpful, they really take their time and care about your concern and your pets.
You get appointments quickly, and they respond very quickly over EMail.
The prices are really fair (cheap), and they speak good English!

Definitely recommend!
Besides being professional, they are very humane. I recommend them.

Professionalism combined with unconditional love for all animals was my choice from the start to care for my favorite furry friend. A fantastic team of professionals, under the wonderful Dr. Rita Fonseca. A sure bet for the care and affection our pets deserve!!!
